name: Treadmill Running
steps: Start a treadmill at a slow walk, increase the belt speed gradually to your target running pace, and run centered near the middle of the deck.
Stand tall with a subtle forward lean from your ankles, elbows bent near 90 degrees, and relaxed shoulders.
Run with light, crisp alternating strides landing softly beneath your hips while pumping your arms forward and back in rhythm.
Maintain a continuous pace for the target duration or distance, then slow smoothly down to a walk before stepping off.
tips: Look straight ahead rather than down at the display or your feet so your posture stays tall and balanced.
Keep your cadence light and avoid overstriding far ahead of your center of mass.
